jobs.title: Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

The role will be accountable for delivering implementation specifications and conduct production data assessment for any model implementations for EQB’s Advanced Internal Ratings Based (“AIRB”) approach for Pillar I regulatory capital models, the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (“ICAAP”) for Pillar II credit risk models, for IFRS 9 provisioning. This role will play a crucial supporting role in building an efficient way to implement risk models and risk reporting data within Equitable Bank.

jobs.description_text: About the Role You’ll play a senior, hands-on role in Kpler’s Graphic Design team, taking creative work from the first spark of an idea through to final delivery. Using graphic design and motion, you’ll bring Kpler’s data, expertise, and stories to life in ways that earn attention, simplify complexity, and leave a lasting impression. jobs.title: Senior LNG & Natural Gas Analyst (Europe focus)
jobs.description_text: As a Senior LNG & Natural Gas Analyst, you will play a key role in driving Kpler’s European natural gas and global LNG market research offering. Operating at the intersection of quantitative modeling, market analysis, and client engagement, you will build and maintain forecasting models that translate complex energy flows into clear, actionable intelligence. Working as part of the LNG & Natural Gas Insight team, you will regularly publish market-defining reports and engage directly with clients, industry leaders, and media to present Kpler’s house views.

jobs.title: Senior LNG Market Analyst
jobs.description_text: As a Senior LNG Market Analyst, you will play a central role in driving the accuracy, depth, and strategic value of Kpler’s global Gas & LNG intelligence. Embedded within the Gas & LNG market operations team, you will bridge the gap between physical market dynamics and advanced data analytics to maintain trusted cargo-level data. Working closely with Product, Engineering, News, and Sales teams, you will turn complex trade datasets into actionable insights and shape future platform developments for our global clients.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Marine Insurance
jobs.description_text: As Senior Product Manager, Marine Insurance, you will own the Marine Insurance product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address critical challenges across the marine insurance value chain. Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
jobs.description_text: As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.

jobs.description_text: As a Refined Products Inventory Analyst, you will play a central role in powering Kpler's storage intelligence and driving the expansion of our brand-new inventory product from regional hubs to global coverage. Operating at the intersection of data operations, satellite imagery validation, and oil market analysis, you will ensure the precision, completeness, and strategic value of our global refined products dataset. By mapping terminal infrastructure and translating complex data into actionable market intelligence, you will directly empower commodity traders and market participants to navigate evolving energy dynamics with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst, Fuel oil
jobs.description_text: As we look to build out the role of research within Kpler we are adding experienced market professionals with solid backgrounds across the worlds of trading, refining, fundamental analytics and consulting. The successful candidate will be instrumental in expanding the geographical scope of our dirty product research offering, by adding Europe-based fuel oil and residue, expertise. This role will be pivotal in expanding our footprint in the European area and also be of great help to the growing client engagement team.

Operating with high autonomy, you will oversee end-to-end field operations across the United States—identifying optimal locations, negotiating access with private landowners, and installing physical sensor infrastructure. In this dynamic role, your field execution directly expands our proprietary ground network, empowering global commodity and energy markets with real-time, actionable insights.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Tax Expert to join our growing Finance team and provide operational support across Kpler’s global tax activities. In this role, you will work closely with the Group Tax Manager, Finance teams and external tax advisors to support tax analysis, projections, compliance, transfer pricing and international tax matters. This is a hands-on role with global exposure, offering the opportunity to work across multiple jurisdictions and contribute to tax-related projects and process improvements. You will play an important role in ensuring Kpler’s tax requirements are managed accurately and efficiently, while supporting the wider Finance organisation and helping to identify potential tax risks. The ideal candidate will be analytical, organised and comfortable working with financial data, external advisors and stakeholders across the business. You will be able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and communicate tax matters clearly to both tax and non-tax audiences.

This role manages the supplier lifecycle end-to-end, from sourcing and selection through negotiation, onboarding, delivery, and ongoing performance management for the Company’s most important vendors. jobs.description_text: At the heart of Mirego’s growth, your role as a Business Development Representative for the Toronto area is essential to identifying and qualifying new opportunities. As the first point of contact for current and prospective clients, you build strong, engaging relationships while clearly communicating the value of our solutions. Your primary objective is to target and engage prospects, drawing a deep understanding of their needs and aligning them with Mirego’s service offerings. You will also contribute to managing and growing existing accounts, ensuring the successful delivery of ongoing projects and identifying additional opportunities.

jobs.title: Candidature spontanée
jobs.description_text: Nous sommes toujours ouverts à des candidats·e·s intéressants·e·s! Tu ne trouves pas le poste idéal pour toi dans la liste actuelle? N'hésite pas à nous faire parvenir ta candidature et nous assurerons un suivi auprès de toi. Si aucune opportunité ne correspond actuellement à ton profil, nous la conserverons en vue d'opportunités futures!

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Faire évoluer nos produits par petits pas, avec une rétroaction constante de l'équipe et de nos clients, c'est pour nous la façon la plus efficace de créer de la vraie valeur. En tant que chargé·e de projet Agile, tu es au cœur de cette dynamique. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu sais motiver les équipes pour assurer la livraison des projets de manière optimale, tout en respectant le budget, le calendrier et la portée.

jobs.title: Contrôleur(e) financier(ère)
jobs.description_text: En tant que Contrôleur·e financier·ère, tu assures la rigueur, la fiabilité et l'amélioration continue de l'information financière qui sert à la prise de décision. Tu agis comme partenaire d'affaires auprès des équipes, en traduisant les données financières en analyses claires et actionnables qui éclairent la rentabilité, les marges et les coûts. Tu profites de chaque occasion pour moderniser les façons de faire de la fonction finance, en tirant parti des outils technologiques et de l'intelligence artificielle pour simplifier le travail de ton équipe. Tu sais que ton succès se mesure à une information financière plus fiable et plus rapidement disponible, à une rentabilité mieux comprise et mieux suivie, et à une équipe qui adopte avec enthousiasme de nouveaux outils. Ce poste est pour toi si tu souhaites grandir avec la fonction finance et prendre éventuellement plus de responsabilités dans un contexte d'entreprise en évolution.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) IA
jobs.description_text: En tant que personne dédiée au développement IA, tu contribues chaque jour à la création de solutions d'intelligence artificielle innovantes qui ont pour ambition de transformer concrètement la façon dont nos clients font des affaires. Tu fais le pont entre le développement logiciel et l'univers de l'IA, en concevant des systèmes agentiques, des pipelines RAG et des solutions exploitant les modèles les plus performants du marché. Ton enthousiasme pour l'IA et ta curiosité insatiable t'incitent à rester à l'avant-garde d'un écosystème en constante évolution. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellentes solutions IA qui t'apportent de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. C'est pourquoi tu aspires constamment à collaborer avec les personnes les plus talentueuses, afin de progresser et d'évoluer collectivement.

jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer (Enterprise)
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The AI & Automation Engineer helps teams work smarter by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and apply AI where it can add meaningful value. Working across Business Applications, Data & Analytics, and IT, you will build practical solutions that simplify work, improve efficiency, and support business outcomes. This role reports to the VP of Business Systems. Please note: This role requires hands-on coding experience, and candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their technical skills during the interview process.

jobs.title: Country Manager - Public Sector
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Join a Sales Team That Drives Impact: A warm, established territory – You’re not starting from scratch. Step into a region with an active book of business, loyal customers, and white-space opportunities ready to grow. Full-funnel support – You’ll have a dedicated SDR team generating qualified meetings, regional marketing managers driving local campaigns and events, and a world-class marketing engine fueling inbound demand. Deep technical backup – Partner with Platform Consultants and Solutions Consultants who help you shape strategy, demo with precision, and unlock expansion inside your accounts. Upsell and cross-sell motion first – Your immediate wins come from growing existing customers with new solutions, and platform conversions — not just chasing new logos. Best-in-class products and mission – Sell technology that forensics examiners, investigators, prosecutors, and other law enforcement leaders actually love using — tools that make a measurable impact in protecting communities and saving lives. True career runway – Be part of a rapidly expanding sales org with mentorship, leadership visibility, and a clear path towards established goals.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Director, Cloud Engineering is responsible for the strategy, operation, security, governance, and financial stewardship of Magnet's cloud platform and shared engineering services. This Leader partners closely with Engineering, Product, UX, Security, IT, Compliance, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure our cloud platform enables rapid product innovation while meeting the highest standards for reliability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. This role combines technical acumen, operational excellence, cloud strategy, AI enablement, Financial Operations ("FinOps") discipline, vendor management, and organizational leadership. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for ensuring Magnet's cloud platform remains secure, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and capable of powering the next generation of digital investigation products. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Director, Public Sector Sales - LATAM
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics, a leader in digital forensics solutions, is seeking a dynamic Director of Sales to lead a team of Account Managers covering the LATAM region. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the team to exceed revenue targets and execute the company’s go-to-market strategy. The Director will actively engage in the region to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities while fostering a high-performance team culture. Collaborating cross-functionally across the Company, the Director will ensure alignment to achieve revenue goals. The ideal candidate is a proven sales leader with exceptional coaching, presentation and selling skills.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive – North Asia
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to grow our private-sector business across North Asia. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important market and play a central role in expanding Magnet Forensics’ enterprise presence across Japan and North Asia. This role will focus on Japan as the primary market and have additional responsibility for South Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong. The successful candidate will build pipeline, acquire new enterprise customers and expand strategic existing accounts. We are looking for a senior cybersecurity salesperson with strong relationships across the Japanese enterprise market, particularly with CISOs, SOC leaders and incident response teams. They will own complex sales cycles from initial engagement through to close, working with customers, partners, marketing and sales engineering.

jobs.title: Facilities Security Officer
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewAre you passionate about security, compliance, and supporting mission-critical work? We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Security Officer (FSO) to lead and maintain our government security clearance programs! In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator of the company's Facility Clearance (FCL) and personnel security clearance program, helping ensure our continued ability to perform classified work for Government customers. You will also play a critical role in managing compliance with Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) requirements, supporting facility clearance eligibility, government reporting obligations, and mitigation activities. You'll partner with employees, leadership, government representatives, and cross-functional teams to maintain compliance, support cleared personnel and strengthen our overall security posture. NOTE: Due to minor traveling required to the Facility location, Candidates must reside in OR around the greater Chantilly, Virginia area.

jobs.title: Platform Consultant
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven Platform Consultant to play a critical role in driving Sales success for Magnet’s platform products. The successful candidate will play a key role as an internal advisor to our Sales teams and will be an integral resource in navigating large, complex sales opportunities. They will also assist in proactive market engagement and business development activities to identify and increase demand for our platform products leading to increased solution sales success. A second European language especially Spanish would be a distinct advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform - Magnet One
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet One is the connective layer across our product portfolio, and the platform team builds the foundations every other team depends on: how customer organizations are structured, how users prove who they are, how purchases turn into working access, and how our own teams support all of it. Our customers are getting larger and structurally more complex - bigger agencies, federated deployments, stricter identity and data residency requirements - and the foundational decisions ahead deserve dedicated ownership rather than being made a ticket at a time. That's the role: one person who owns this domain end to end and gives it a deliberate direction. This is a builder's role with an unusually direct line to customer pain. Our administrators are IT and operations staff at law enforcement agencies, government labs, and enterprises - people who work under strict security policies, have limited tolerance for surprises, and often manage access for dozens or hundreds of investigators. Getting their experience right is a competitive advantage. Getting it wrong shows up as support tickets, stalled deployments, and renewals at risk.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Nexus team, responsible for delivering capabilities across Nexus and the broader Magnet One (M1) platform. You will help build and evolve cloud-native solutions that streamline digital forensics workflows and provide a seamless experience across our products. As a senior member of the team, you will help shape the future of the platform by designing and delivering scalable solutions across the technology stack. You'll collaborate closely with Product, UX, and Engineering partners, contribute to architectural decisions, and drive the delivery of high-quality features in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test to help build and sustain high-quality software through strong test design, automation, and collaboration with engineering partners. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for someone who understands modern quality practices and wants to continue developing technical depth, product judgment, and influence. Very important to be comfortable building with agent-assisted and agentic workflows. You will work closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and Senior Quality Leaders to ensure quality is built in early and continuously, not added at the end. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable owning quality for features or services, contributes meaningfully to automation and CI/CD flows, and is ready to grow toward more senior technical leadership. NOTE: Candidate must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, GKOS
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe’re looking for a talented Software Engineer who excels in technical problem-solving. You’re skilled at developing and shipping high-quality code, with a hunger to learn, and a desire to build things that make a difference. As a Software Engineer, you’ll contribute directly to our products by supporting customers and developing new features. Your work will help product teams deliver faster, safer, and more consistent customer experiences. You’ll actively collaborate with peers in Engineering and UX to build core user experiences on our Graykey platform. NOTE: Candidate must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Staff UX Designer, AI & Agentic Experiences
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewA Staff UX Designer is an advanced individual contributor with a broad sphere of influence, expected to lead design initiatives both directly and through other designers. They serve as visionaries, strategists, and mentors within the design team, shaping product direction, influencing organisational decisions, and driving user-centred innovation at scale. You thrive in ambiguity, excel at solving complex problems, and lead through expertise and influence rather than authority. You bring deep experience in UX strategy, interaction design, and systems thinking, with a passion for creating intuitive, trustworthy, and effective AI and agentic experiences. You are equally comfortable defining long-term experience vision, guiding product strategy, mentoring other designers, and partnering with Product and Engineering leaders to deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes. As a strategic design leader, you will champion the voice of the user, establish experience standards for AI-powered products, and ensure user experience is considered alongside product and technical decisions from concept through delivery. NOTE: Candidate must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Technical Support Engineer provides advanced troubleshooting and resolution for complex customer issues. This role works with greater autonomy, mentors other Technical Support Engineers, and contributes to knowledge creation and continuous improvement across support process and tooling. This position reports to the Manager, Technical Support.

Working closely with the Senior Manager, Copy, this person will be a key creative partner in shaping how NOBULL communicates through every channel. They’ll own projects from brief to execution, help apply and evolve NOBULL’s voice, and bring creativity, clarity, and consistency to the work. The ideal candidate is equal parts creative thinker and hands-on writer, someone who can develop the big idea, write the headline, and make sure every detail lands.

jobs.title: Sr. Systems & Security Administrator
jobs.description_text: The Senior Systems & Security Administrator is a senior, hands-on technical role responsible for the administration, security, and continuous improvement of NOBULL's technology environment. This role owns NOBULL's core cloud, identity, endpoint, network, collaboration, and security platforms, ensuring they remain secure, reliable, and aligned with business needs. Working closely with the VP of Information Technology, business stakeholders, vendors, and managed service providers, this individual serves as a senior technical resource within IT, driving operational excellence, automation, and platform maturity. The role offers the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership responsibilities as the organization continues to evolve.

jobs.title: Contact Center Operations Specialist (InnovateNJ)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Contact Center Operations Specialist with 5 years of experience in help desk operations, support team training, or platform administration while delivering excellent customer service. In this role, you'll oversee chat and contact center operations. This includes creating training materials, protocols, and documentation that help support teams work independently. You'll improve customer service quality by analyzing support data and coaching staff, and work with technical specialists to configure and optimize our Amazon Connect platform. Strong candidates are comfortable with platform configuration, automation, and data analysis and understand help desk work well enough to train others. This position reports to the Product Director and collaborates closely with teams in the Business Experience and Residential Experience Initiatives and directly with state agency partners.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Director of Product to co-lead our product management team and advance the product management practice within the office. This role focuses on empowering product managers to lead their teams effectively, ensuring that our solutions deliver value to New Jersey residents and business owners. You will champion product management excellence, oversee project staffing, and mentor a diverse and talented team, while also contributing to project work. Working closely with directors in product design, engineering, and content design you will foster a culture of collaboration and innovation, driving user impact and continuous improvement in our work. We are seeking candidates with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience in product management, along with at least 2 years of experience in people management. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned product manager adept at guiding end-to-end development, product planning, and execution, contributing to both product practice development and broader leadership and management functions within the office. This role will report to the Chief Innovation Officer, co-lead the product team with the current director of product, and work closely with initiative leads and other team members across the office.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (InnovateNJ)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking product managers with at least 7 years of experience leading cross-functional teams using data-driven decision making, equitable human-centered design, agile methodologies, and modern practices. You should have demonstrable success solving complex and highly-ambiguous problems in bureaucratic settings, yet preserve an agile and adaptive approach to this role. You should be comfortable working in a startup environment where you think independently and operate with a high degree of autonomy. We’re looking for self-starters who are skilled at driving projects forward while communicating and collaborating closely with the team. In this role you will be embedded directly with a state agency to employ evidence-based, human-centered, and participatory methodologies and co-create solutions alongside agency staff, transferring skills and methodologies. This position reports to NJIA’s Product Director and will be embedded directly with an agency partner.

jobs.title: Office Administrator
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an Office Administrator to our team. In this position, you will support the day-to-day administrative operations of the company by coordinating business activities, managing office operations, and providing administrative support that enables efficient business operations. This role contributes to organizational effectiveness by coordinating schedules, supporting departmental initiatives, maintaining business records, and improving administrative processes that support operational success. Working cross-functionally with employees, managers, vendors, and business stakeholders, this role supports administrative operations, office logistics, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and business activities while ensuring services align with organizational priorities and established procedures.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description_text: CesiumAstro is expanding its global footprint with the establishment of a new office in Munich, Germany. We are looking to add a Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition to the team who will play a critical leadership role in building and supporting this next phase of CesiumAstro’s growth in Europe. In this position, you will lead talent acquisition efforts for CesiumAstro’s Munich office, developing and executing the recruiting strategy required to build the organization from the ground up. The Senior Manager will partner closely with leadership, human resources, and functional leaders to translate business and workforce plans into an effective hiring strategy for Germany and the broader European talent market.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description_text: In this position, you will play a critical role in creating a thoughtful, organized, and high-quality recruiting experience from the first candidate interaction through the interview process. You will partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications and logistics, and keep the hiring process moving. Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of those details and represents our culture with professionalism, urgency, and care. This is a fast moving role that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and strong communication. The ideal candidate is a true team player who can quickly understand business needs, stay ahead of competing priorities, and take pride in delivering a high quality experience for candidates and internal teams alike

jobs.title: Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany.
